'''Star Tours Flight 903''' was the designation of a [[Star Tours/Legends|Star Tours]] travel agency flight to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. On the day of the [[Raid at Spaceport THX1138]], it was on time and scheduled to depart from the spaceport's Gate 1F at 1945 hours.
